name: Commutation of controls (C)
summary: One of the two new axioms of the Jeandel–Perdrix–Vilmart Clifford+T axiomatisation: a three-input diagram parametrised by α, β, γ is symmetric under exchanging the roles of α and β.
description:
This is one of the two axioms that Jeandel, Perdrix and Vilmart added to the ZX-calculus to obtain the first complete axiomatisation for Clifford+T. It is parametrised by three arbitrary angles $\alpha$, $\beta$ and $\gamma$ and holds for all of them. It arose from the translation between the ZX- and ZW-calculi used in the completeness proof and, as its name says, expresses that two *controlled* operations commute. When it was introduced, no derivation from the previous axioms was known.

Going from left to right, the phases $\alpha$ and $\beta$ swap places, and the positions of $\gamma$ and $-\gamma$ are exchanged. Since the rule is *linear* in its parameters, it also holds in the universal fragment, where it remains an axiom of the complete axiomatisations of Jeandel, Perdrix and Vilmart.
